AboutSection.heading: About Me
AboutSection.description: As a passionate Front-end Developer specializing in React, I enjoy building modern, scalable, and user-focused web applications. I thrive in collaborative environments where I can contribute to meaningful projects, continuously expand my skills, and stay up to date with the latest technologies. My goal is to create high-quality, performant, and intuitive digital experiences that deliver real value to users.
